name: 16870 · Port Matilda, PA
findings: ZIP 16870 (Port Matilda) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16870 (Port Matilda) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
